slots.hair: mid-length and slightly wavy, in low double braids
slots.outfit: a beige apron with nothing under it but a white fitted vest, flour on her collarbones and arms
slots.place: upstairs in the old house in the afternoon after finishing work, a fan turning and louvre shadows across the wall
slots.action: She is sitting on the wooden floor against the wall with the apron still on and the flour still on her.
slots.face: A tired but very loose smile, her eyes on the lens.
slots.light: The slanting tropical light through the louvres comes from in front of her, the shadow of the fan moves across her, and the inner side of the room is dark.

slots.place: at the low table upstairs in the old house with today's failed bake sitting on it
slots.action: She is sitting cross-legged holding the piece that came out wrong with a bite already taken from it.
slots.face: Still chewing, laughing at herself in a slightly daft way.
slots.light: The afternoon light from the window comes from one side in front of her and the depth of the room is dark, the whole picture warm.

slots.outfit: a butter-yellow cotton towel wrapped around her
slots.place: in the bathroom of the old house with its green tiles at half past three in the morning, about to go down and start the oven
slots.action: Her free hand is pushing her hair back off her face as she comes up from washing it.
slots.face: Not awake, her eyes half open.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and both the depth of the bathroom and the night outside the window are black.

slots.hair: mid-length, tied up out of the way
slots.outfit: a beige apron over a wood-brown short-sleeved top with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder
slots.place: in the ground-floor studio in the hot part of the afternoon with all three fans running and the cat on the window ledge
slots.action: She has one hand braced on the work bench and is pushing a tray into the oven with the other, the cat on the ledge behind her.
slots.face: Her attention is on the oven and not the lens, with sweat on her forehead.
slots.light: The window light of the studio comes from in front of her, the shadow of a fan sweeps across, and the depth of the room is dark.

slots.outfit: an old-tile-green cropped knit and a rattan-beige long skirt
slots.place: under the eaves of an old street in George Town at dusk, just after a shower of rain
slots.action: She is standing under the eaves waiting for the rain to stop with a paper box for a customer in one hand.
slots.face: A very soft smile with her eyes narrowed.
slots.light: The dusk light beyond the eaves falls on her face and the depth of the covered walkway is dark.
